newsitem.title: EGYPT: Faisal Islamic Bank H1 profits rise.
newsitem.headline: Faisal Islamic Bank H1 profits rise.

text.p: Faisal Islamic Bank of Egypt raised net profits in the first half of the Islamic year 1417 to 166 million pounds ($49 million) from 142 million for the same period a year ago, the bank said on Monday.
The bank said the first half of its financial year ended on November 11, 1996. In the previous Islamic year, it ended on 27 August, 1995.
Customer deposits also rose by 2.8 percent to 5.04 billion from 4.90 billion while assets rose by 4.2 percent to 6.56 billion from 6.29 billion.
The bank does pay interest which is forbidden in Islam. Its shares are listed on the Egyptian stock exchange in Egyptian pounds and U.S. dollars.
In October, sources at the bank said it was planning to raise its capital by $50 million and may allow foreign shareholders to own a majority stake. The bank now has capital of about $100 million.
